lines.en: Listen, um, I need to ask you something.
Okay, you know how my stepdad's in prison?
Well, um, listen, he was supposed to get a weekend furlough
so he could come to the wedding tomorrow.
But he just called and, um...
Well, apparently, stabbing Iceman in the exercise yard
And so there's no one to walk me down the aisle.
And, um, well, I would just really love it if you would do it.
Yeah, you've, you know, sort of been like a dad to me.
I mean, you've always, you know, looked out for me
I hope you know how much you mean to me.
I don't want you to see your father cry.
